name: toolchain
command:
test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files "*.go"))"
go mod tidy
git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum
go mod verify
go vet -p 2 ./...
go build -p 2 ./...

name: repeatable
command:
mkdir -p "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/a/src"
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/a/src"
(cd "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/a/src" && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -p 2 -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/Busnes-app/kyrecovery-server/internal/appversion.release=0.0.0" -o "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/a/kyrecovery" cmd/kyrecovery/main.go)
mkdir -p "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/elsewhere/b/src"
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/elsewhere/b/src"
(cd "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/elsewhere/b/src" && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -p 2 -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/Busnes-app/kyrecovery-server/internal/appversion.release=0.0.0" -o "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/elsewhere/b/kyrecovery" cmd/kyrecovery/main.go)
sha256sum "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/a/kyrecovery" "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/elsewhere/b/kyrecovery"
cmp "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/a/kyrecovery" "/tmp/kyrecovery-repeatable-o_lmmwwi/elsewhere/b/kyrecovery"
